title: Ocellated
summary: O'CELLATED, adjective [Latin ocellatus, from ocellus, a little eye.] 1. Resembling an eye. 2. Formed with the figues of little eyes.

inlines.v: O'CELLATED, adjective [Latin ocellatus, from ocellus, a little eye.] 1. Resembling an eye. 2. Formed with the figues of little eyes.
